title: Collapse transition of a heterogeneous polymer in a crowded medium.
one_liner_zh: 该文用分子动力学模拟研究异质聚合物（含大单体模拟RNA聚合酶结合）在拥挤环境中的塌缩转变，虽涉及DNA链压缩与转录单元聚集，但对象为通用聚合物模型而非TF-DNA特异性互作，方法为MD模拟，与课题有间接启发。
abstract: Long chain molecules can be entropically compacted in a crowded medium. We study the compaction transition of a heterogeneous polymer with ring topology by crowding effects in a free or confined space. For this, we use molecular dynamics simulations in which the effects of crowders are taken into account through effective interactions between chain segments. Our parameter choices are inspired by the Escherichia coli chromosome. The polymer consists of small and big monomers; the big monomers dispersed along the backbone are to mimic the binding of RNA polymerases. Our results show that the compaction transition is a two-step process: initial compaction induced by the association (clustering) of big monomers followed by a gradual overall compaction. They also indicate that cylindrical confinement makes the initial transition more effective; for representative parameter choices, the initial compaction accounts for about 60% reduction in the chain size. Our simulation results support the view that crowding promotes clustering of active transcription units into transcription factories.
abstract_zh: 长链分子在拥挤介质中可因熵效应而压缩。我们研究了在自由或受限空间中，拥挤效应对具有环状拓扑结构的异质聚合物的压缩转变。为此，我们采用分子动力学模拟，其中拥挤剂的影响通过链段间的有效相互作用来考虑。我们的参数选择灵感来源于大肠杆菌染色体。聚合物由小单体和大单体组成；大单体沿主链分散，用以模拟RNA聚合酶的结合。我们的结果表明，压缩转变是一个两步过程：首先由大单体的结合（聚集）引发初始压缩，随后逐渐整体压缩。结果还表明，圆柱形限制使初始转变更为有效；对于代表性参数选择，初始压缩约占链尺寸减少的60%。我们的模拟结果支持拥挤促进活性转录单元聚集形成转录工厂的观点。
